connector.name: e2a - email for AI agents by Mnexa-AI
connector.registryDescription: Authenticated email gateway for AI agents - per-agent inboxes, HITL approval, SPF/DKIM verified.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.e2a.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mnexa-ai account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: accepts an e2a API key (e2a_…) or OAuth 2.1 access token (ate2a_…)

env.name: E2A_AGENT_EMAIL
env.description: Default agent inbox (e.g. bot@your-domain.com). Optional — single-agent accounts auto-resolve.

env.name: E2A_BASE_URL
env.description: Self-hosted e2a backend URL. Defaults to https://e2a.dev.
